package com.mukasanches.zapptv.data

import java.text.Normalizer
import java.util.Locale

object ChannelResolver {
    fun canonicalId(name: String): String? {
        val value = normalize(name)
        return when {
            value.contains("tv camara") || value == "camara" -> "BR_TV_CAMARA"
            value.contains("tv senado") || value == "senado" -> "BR_TV_SENADO"
            value.contains("tv brasil internacional") -> "BR_TV_BRASIL_INT"
            value == "tv brasil" || value.startsWith("tv brasil ") -> "BR_TV_BRASIL"
            value.contains("tv cultura") || value == "cultura" -> "BR_TV_CULTURA"
            value.contains("globo") -> "BR_GLOBO"
            value.contains("sbt") -> "BR_SBT"
            value.contains("record news") -> "BR_RECORD_NEWS"
            value.contains("record") -> "BR_RECORD"
            value.contains("band") -> "BR_BAND"
            value.contains("redetv") || value.contains("rede tv") -> "BR_REDETV"
            else -> null
        }
    }

    fun normalize(value: String): String {
        val noAccent = Normalizer.normalize(value, Normalizer.Form.NFD)
            .replace(Regex("\\p{Mn}+"), "")
        return noAccent
            .lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
            .replace(Regex("[^a-z0-9]+"), " ")
            .trim()
    }
}
